$comment: Gotchi data layer — reuses AarcadeGh-t's home Cloudflare tunnel (UserDefaultTunnel on the iMac). No local indexers needed.

auth.note: Compat proxy supports optional proxy key; currently not enforced. Set GOTCHIBOT_SUBGRAPH_PROXY_KEY in abracadabra if enforcement is enabled.

identityLayer.$comment: cartridgeSim is the Vercel origin GotchiBot uses (service key). Vercel /api/cartridge-sim thin-relays to cartridgeSimProxy → iMac 127.0.0.1:8791 (aarcade-cartridge-sim). Do not point GotchiBot writes at iMac :3010 (lore API, sim disabled). Direct cartridgeSimProxy needs X-Cartridge-Sim-Proxy-Key, which abra gotchibot does not inject. Override via GOTCHIBOT_CARTRIDGE_URL / AARCADE_SIM_URL / CARTRIDGE_SIM.

lanNote: iMac LAN ports are not directly reachable from the MBP (firewall/AP isolation) — always go through the tunnel hostnames, never http://192.168.1.162:*
